Hello everyone! After many long nights and days working with my son to bring his game vision to life, it’s finally coming together the way he imagined. After countless ideas, changes, fixes, and redesigns, he’s finally happy with it and excited to show it off to his friends at school.

A while back I posted about our game, Miner Clicker — originally just a chill, relaxing mining block clicking game. But during this long journey the project evolved into something much bigger than we expected.

We’ve added:

* Multiplayer
* PVP raids
* Boss battles
* Deck cards
* Perks to sabotage other players
* Rank & leveling system
* Chat system
* Leaderboards
* Clans
* Real-time market
* Forge system
* And much more

One of the coolest parts is that the game also uses a local Ollama AI setup that helps generate card names, item names, market decisions, and even adjusts market values based on player sales and activity.

This started as a fun project between me and my son, and seeing how passionate he’s become about game development has honestly been the best part of the whole experience.

We recently finished setting up an installer, but the game can also be played directly on the website if anyone wants to try it out. Feedback is always welcome!
